general.bend_radius_and_k: no per-thickness table is published; the quote tool sets them per part. Design guide: inside radius about 1 T for most metals (5052-H32 about 1 T; 6061-T6 2-3 T).
general.k_guideline: mild steel 0.30-0.40, aluminum 0.33-0.50, stainless 0.40-0.50 (to be confirmed by test bends)
general.min_hole: at least T/2 and at least 1.0

notes: The multiples of T are JLCCNC's published design-guide rules, not per-thickness shop limits. hole_to_edge and hole_to_bend are hole edge to sheet edge and to the bend tangent line.
Stock thicknesses within 0.5-6.0 mm are not listed on the public pages.
